bundle.shortDescription: Look up public Snapchat profiles and save their media
bundle.longDescription: SnapIntel shows what a public Snapchat profile publishes on snapchat.com (profile details, story, highlights, Spotlight and lenses) and saves media with a manifest that can be verified later.
